maria: quick sync  i'm drafting the docs changelog for the small site push. items: fallback routing snippet, streaming-embeddings truncation on large payloads, one redirect, and a tiny go sdk snippet fix. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4410

sam: keep whatsnew as 3 terse bullets so it's parsable by partners. no marketing language.

maria: agreed. bullets only + links to migration guide.

chris: pushed a small go example fix (iterator usage + defer close). please verify render.

lee: filed PR #4411 to add a temporary redirect for /docs/dedicated/autoscale -> /docs/dedicated/scaling.

jen: adding a 4-line node snippet for fallback routing in the whatsnew box.

maria: paste snippet here so i can sanity-check formatting.

jen: ```js
// minimal fallback routing
const c = new Redwood(process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY)
await c.generate({model: 'redwood-kitefish-v1', fallbacks: ['redwood-kitefish-v1-quant','gpt-compatible-fallback']})
```

sam: add one-line parenthetical: (Quantized fallback may tokenize differently; verify prompts & stop tokens.)

maria: will add parenthetical + link to quantization guide. i'll update the PR tonight and request LGTM by 07:00 UTC.

docs-bot: reminder  staging deploy scheduled for tomorrow 09:00 UTC after signoff.

chris: LGTM  examples build locally.

lee: LGTM (redirect PR included).

jen: LGTM  minor wording suggestion on the PR.

maria: thanks all  i'll squash & merge after edits and ping here when staging is live. :rocket:
